title: Sex
author: Madonna
current_text: The Tokyo Customs Office ruled that portions of Madonna’s Sex were obscene and seized copies brought in by travelers at airports. In Houston, TX, Citizens Against Pornography sought to have Sex removed; the public library kept it but stopped circulation and restricted in-library access to adults. In Mesa, AZ, the mayor ordered the library not to shelve Sex. The Pikes Peak (CO) Library in Colorado Springs cancelled its order for Sex after citizen protest. The St. Louis (MO) Public Library cancelled its order for Sex after citizen protest.
